<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
I've received Brad's response, and it's not good news. None of the times I found work for Elena and David. This means I need to re-evaluate the schedules and find more available slots for Priya and Marcus. Brad has proposed a plan: he will find common slots for Elena and David and send them to me. This is a good idea. To be proactive, I will also re-examine the calendars of Priya and Marcus and compile a complete list of their common availabilities, not just the few I sent before. This way, when Brad sends his list, I can quickly find the overlap. I will start by reading the calendars again to make sure I have the most up-to-date information.
</SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
